integrity.claim_scope: One sharp dimension-and-iteration boundary for classical unpreconditioned CG on Stieltjes systems.
integrity.computational_role: The checker verifies only the explicit witness and algebraic identities; it is not used as an infinite proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic finite-termination argument in dimensions at most two plus an exact-rational three-dimensional witness.

scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic only; no finite-precision or preconditioned-CG claim is made.
The result gives the minimal dimension and iteration of possible sign loss, not a classification of all three-dimensional instances.
Residual originality risk remains for older componentwise-monotonicity literature using different terminology.
title: Conjugate-gradient positivity is dimension-protected exactly through two dimensions
